day1_insight: Recent rain (11 mm over the past few days) is washing urban runoff into the surf — the single biggest cause of beach contamination — especially near storm drains and creek mouths. The model's main signals right now: 11 mm of rain has fallen, washing bacteria-laden runoff into the surf; limited sunlight is raising risk (less UV to disinfect the water); and high tide timing is lowering risk — how long before mid-morning the last high tide fell, which sets how much the water has just washed off the upper beach. The most recent sample, 4 days ago, was excellent at 20 MPN/100mL.
